summary: IOS-XR supports CLI (network_cli) and NETCONF (netconf, only for iosxr_banner, interface, logging, system and user), both over SSH with keys or -u/-k via bastion, without enable mode; local is deprecated.
questions: Which IOS-XR modules work over NETCONF?
Does IOS-XR support enable mode in Ansible?
Should I use network_cli or netconf for IOS-XR?

answer_card.title: Cisco IOS-XR connection options
answer_card.answer_md:
| | CLI | NETCONF |
|---|---|---|
| Protocol | SSH | XML over SSH |
| Modules | all | only `iosxr_banner`, `iosxr_interface`, `iosxr_logging`, `iosxr_system`, `iosxr_user` |
| Credentials | SSH keys/agent or `-u myuser -k` | same |
| Indirect access | bastion | bastion |
| `ansible_connection` | `ansible.netcommon.network_cli` | `ansible.netcommon.netconf` |
| Enable mode | not supported | not supported |

`ansible_connection: local` is deprecated.
